title: Invariance moments of a uniform cube coordinate
statement: For every natural number $n$ and coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$, give the Boolean cube $\{0,1\}^n$ the product of uniform probability measures on its coordinates. The function that maps a point to the sign of its $i$th bit, with false encoded as $1$ and true as $-1$, satisfies the invariance moment conditions.
